collection.title: Audi TT 1998 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi TT 1998 to 2003 model requires a 22" wiper blade for the drivers and a 21" for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
